|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Black 2 (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-D-black2-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the earliest image found already prints “E”: the PC had issued an errata of this card before its image repository began (8 July 2018), and no image of the earlier text was found. Listed with the [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription errors]] (marks that do not match the version).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-black2022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/black2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/black2.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive primary-source copy]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114002405/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections-first-family-primary-sources-381.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “•Black 2”. Text: “May add 1 pilot. During your deploy phase, may take one Pride Of The Empire into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, All Wings Report In and Organized Attack are canceled. While DS-61-2 piloting, immune to attrition < 5.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Black 2 (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 31 July 2022<ref name="img-black2ab74419">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/black2.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 commit ab74419] (31 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual0-Dark/large/black2.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121522/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab7441976d996222d5b7235219576492a00bd1e2 Internet Archive primary-source copy]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114002405/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections-first-family-primary-sources-381.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref>. '''What changed:''' the errata mark “E” → “E1”; the bottom margin “•Black 2” → “Black 2” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Black 2”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “May add 1 pilot. During your deploy phase, may take one Pride Of The Empire into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, All Wings Report In and Organized Attack are canceled. While DS-61-2 piloting, immune to attrition < 5.”
